name: Market fruit
summary: Pineapple peeled right on the boat is the Cái Răng fruit stop, while the wholesale boats trade pomelos, pineapples, and durians by the sack. Phong Điền’s gardens grow honey oranges, dâu Hạ Châu, red-fleshed jackfruit, seedless durian, and cacao.
origin: Cái Răng boats, the Phong Điền gardens, and Cồn Sơn. The fruit months are June to August.
howToEat: Have it cut on the boat, or eat it in a garden at Mỹ Khánh or Cồn Sơn.
Rambutan, jackfruit, and mangosteen are on the delta’s market boats too.
Come in June to August for the fruit months.
seoTitle: Fruit on the Can Tho boats
seoDescription: Pineapple peeled on the Cái Răng boats, pomelos and durians by the sack, and Phong Điền honey oranges, jackfruit, and cacao.
